summary: Verified all 6 new HomeIVF CRM cases (Lead view & Follow-ups). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases green (note-mandatory 400, followup POST/PATCH/status endpoints, caller-activities empty/create/list newest-first, lead country defaults to India + respects override, /leads/followups/analytics shape + specific-date, /leads/followups/reminders admin + caller-scoped, /export/leads.xlsx admin 200 + caller forbidden, catalogs.followup_status seeded with Completed/Not Done/Rescheduled/Cancelled). Frontend: E2E validated for both admin and caller roles.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by tester: /app/frontend/src/pages/Leads.jsx was crashing the entire Leads page with ReferenceError: 'showExport is not defined'. The `<button data-testid="export-leads-button" onClick={() => setShowExport(true)}>` and `{showExport && <ExportModal .../>}` referenced a state that was never declared. Added `const [showExport, setShowExport] = useState(false);` next to `showCreate`. Without this fix the entire /leads page was a blank white screen with a runtime error banner — Case 6 (Export) would have been unusable in production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 cases verified as admin + caller-scoping verified)

seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_-prefixed leads (TEST_iter35 Lead, TEST_country_default, TEST_country_us) + 2 TEST_ caller activities + 1 TEST_ follow-up. Backend DELETE returned non-2xx (test data left in place — harmless because of TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Follow-ups page route is /followups (not /follow-ups). Follow-up analytics tiles render labels as UPPERCASE (TOTAL/COMPLETED/NOT DONE/RESCHEDULED/CANCELLED/PENDING). Export downloads as homeivf_leads_all.xlsx when dates empty. Caller (agent@homeivf.com) sees only 2 own leads and no export button. FollowUpReminder polls /api/leads/followups/reminders without errors.
verified_flows: Case 1: POST /followups {} → 400; with note → 200 (note+status persisted). PATCH requires note. UI: empty add blocked; add with note appears in list.

Case 2: /caller-activities POST empty → 400; with feedback → creates entry (created_by_name, created_at, feedback). GET newest-first. UI: caller-activities-section + input + add + list all functional; agent name + timestamp shown.
Case 3: POST /leads without country → country='India'. With country='United States' → respected. UI CreateLeadModal Country <select> default value = 'India'.
Case 4: GET /leads/followups/reminders returns {now, reminders:[]} for admin and caller-scoped for caller. No console errors on poll.

Case 5: GET /leads/followups/analytics returns {total, completed, not_done, rescheduled, cancelled, pending} as integers. UI 6 metric tiles present; changing date from today → 2030-01-01 updated Total=1 Completed=1. Inline followup-set-status-<id> dropdown changes status → followup-status-badge-<id> renders.

Case 6: Admin sees 'Export' button beside 'New Lead' in Lead-in-Pipeline; opens modal with export-date-from/to and export-download-button; download triggered → homeivf_leads_all.xlsx (spreadsheet Content-Type, size > 200B). Caller does NOT see export button and API returns 403.
rca of the issue: Leads.jsx used `showExport`/`setShowExport` without declaring the useState hook — likely a copy/typo when adding the new ExportModal in Case 6. React threw ReferenceError during render, blanking the whole Leads route. Fix: added `const [showExport, setShowExport] = useState(false);` alongside the existing `showCreate` state. Reproduction: navigate to /leads as admin → red 'Uncaught runtime errors: showExport is not defined' overlay. After fix, /leads renders normally and Export flow works end-to-end.
